method.name: calibration_inference_atom_mixture4096
method.time_sampler_note: Mixture: probability 0.5 exact t=0, otherwise Uniform U(0.5,1).
method.train_notes: Released DD EMA initialization; 4096 selected genuine teacher pairs, eight proposals per label, one training pass. Allocate half the FM training mass to the exact inference t=0 stage; retain late-prefix supervision for the other half.

filter_evidence.metric: LPIPS-alex-v0.1 between initialized student single-step output and fixed VAR teacher target
filter_evidence.training_targets: Only VAR-teacher token IDs; student output is used solely to select noise/target proposals.
